question:
Study the following figure and answer the question that follows.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4de30bdad2f21c753f81440507111d98563f2488f8237b7fd2d0911a3912d19b.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f78c5d395aeaef347b3d83e53649aa90234478adca3d836e96fcc8f708b1d130.png] 

How many doctors are neither artists nor players?
solution:
**Given:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f78c5d395aeaef347b3d83e53649aa90234478adca3d836e96fcc8f708b1d130.png] 

**Calculation:**

Number of doctors that are neither artists nor players 

= Now of doctors represented in figures lying outside both circle and square 

i.e., triangle - circle - square

As we can see there are 17 such doctors that are neither artists nor players.

**Hence, the Required value is 17.**
